In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the use of low yield cigarettes may not be as safe as some people believe, but it is safer than smoking high yield cigarettes.
the smoking of cigarettes of low yield may be less hazardous to health than the smoking of cigarettes with higher yield but is not without risk.
the use of low yield cigarettes does not eliminate the risk of smoking, but the magnitude of this risk is small.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
smokers who cannot stop smoking might best switch to the lowest yield cigarettes, but the health risks of smoking low yield or any cigarettes are not trivial.
smokers of lower yield are not necessarily less at risk of cardiovascular and other diseases associated with cigarette smoking.
the yield of a cigarette is not an important determinant of its risk.
